about.me: Hello! My name is Vitor Pestana, I'm from Niterói (Rio de Janeiro, Brasil), and I am a Full Stack Web Developer with a primary focus on back-end development. I have always been interested in technology, and over time that interest naturally evolved into a passion for software development. At the same time, I have a deep appreciation for the arts, beauty, logic, and critical thinking. Before pursuing Computer Science, I earned a degree in Philosophy. Although philosophy remains one of my greatest intellectual passions, I eventually discovered my professional calling in software development. Around 2019, I began exploring how software is built, and after writing my first `for` loop in C, I fell in love with programming. As I continued studying computer science fundamentals, I specialized in back-end development and expanded my expertise across the web development stack. Today, philosophy and the arts continue to inspire me intellectually, while Computer Science and Software Engineering are where I have found my professional passion.
about.zeLeiteiro: Above all else, I value Love in life, and professionally it is no different. In everything I do, I leave a part of myself, of my soul, of Love. In Greek, this value is expressed by the word meraki (μεράκι), and I learned it from my family at an early age. It is no coincidence that I proudly highlight my family name, Pestana. My grandfather, known as 'Zé Leiteiro' (Zé milkman), taught me from childhood to put Love into everything I do. He fought in World War II with the Brazilian Navy against the horrors of nazism; he's the man looking into the camera. After the war, he worked as a milkman with Love; we were very poor. Through Love, sweat, and blood, he paved the way for me to become who I am today. Like my war hero, the greatest value I carry is the Love I put into everything I do.

imgs.magiPass:
This system is a website and mobile app that offers discounts on restaurants and attractions for travelers visiting Orlando. You can download the app from the Downloads section.

I was part of the developement team of this web application. This project uses Next.js and Tailwind for the front end and .NET for the back end. The mobile app was developed using React Native.
imgs.saideira:
This is a website and mobile app that provides local breweries and bars deals in the mountain region of Rio de Janeiro, focused on Nova Friburgo.

It is currently under development, so the app is not yet available for download. The team that i'm part of is developing this platform using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, .NET, and React Native for mobile version.
